notes.title: Game Walkthrough
notes.notes:
[b]Hey there, friends![/b] 👋

How’s your adventure in Overtime Pay going? If you’re feeling a bit stuck, don’t worry! Here are some fun tips💡to help you out:



[b]1. Organizing the Papers[/b]

Got a call from the boss? Time to sort those documents! 📄 Pop the printed papers into the fax machine and place the ones with red lines in the paper tray.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139996/85024e00ca824c88d935f83c042c402fdfd642ac.gif[/img]


[b]2. Printer Out of Paper[/b] 🖨️

Uh-oh, the printer’s out of paper! Head over to cubicle B1, grab some paper, and refill that printer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139996/6bf542430800d4e84282234657af3dc1d17fcdd9.gif[/img]


[b]3. Fax Machine Troubles[/b]

Your fax machine is on the fritz. Take the printed papers without red lines to the fax machine in cubicle B3. 📠
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139996/4769f62ec42b3a14e8241216b2eb0015b032ff40.gif[/img]


[b]4. Press the Magic Button[/b]

Press the button on the wall on the other side of the office. 🔘 Watch as the office transforms dramatically! Keep moving towards the exit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139996/c0e79aceb7167d2d64deeabf9c7947828e9ac28c.gif[/img]


[b]5. Run Through the Tunnel![/b]🏃‍♂️

We’re now in a tunnel. Why are shadows creeping in? Follow the phone’s instructions and run! When you hit a dead end, take a leap of faith and jump!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139996/07317b8587517cb9a8ba858af07c4f71e83d269f.gif[/img]


[b]6. Where Am I?[/b] 

You’ve landed in a mysterious place. Look, there’s a printed paper under a tree. 🌲
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139996/e6c47c35ffa757d735b1fda5687a334bf590296e.gif[/img]

[b]Ending A: Overtime Mistakes[/b] 

Climb the pyramid-like mountain with the printed paper. Place the paper in the fax machine and answer the phone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139996/7a94e0806d5692b58a1c8d85b90846e65f9c7c97.gif[/img]

[b]Ending B: The Hidden Path[/b]🛤️

Did you check the printed paper closely? Walk past the pyramid and keep going until you find a paper tray. Place the printed paper in the tray. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139996/992b9fc755086bcf42deddd10a226f9e4cad77bd.gif[/img]



[b]Have a blast playing the game![/b] 🎮

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime📧 
Thank you!
